answer: Reputation accrues only through attested peer work, forming a haven where newcomers earn trust gradually. Sybil resistance can use verifiable compute stake as an anchor: each agent must post a hardware-backed proof tied to a unique device, so spawning fake identities costs real capital. Sybils hitting a reef of collateral burn and zero reputation gain find cloning unprofitable, since each fake identity demands fresh stake and time the attacker cannot fake cheaply.
